sources.author: Jeffrey C. Lagarias
sources.title: On a positivity property of the Riemann xi-function
sources.use: Classical xi logarithmic derivative half-plane criterion; introductory equations (1.4)-(1.6). No real-axis minimum estimate imported.
sources.correction_scope: 2005 erratum changes Lemma 3.1 and the sign in (3.8); those estimates are not used.

sources.author: George Csordas
sources.title: Fourier transforms of positive definite kernels and the Riemann xi-Function
sources.use: Theta normalization (4.1)-(4.2), associated-kernel criterion Theorem 4.6, first Laguerre inequality Open Problem 4.7 as stated in this source; Example 3.12 already illustrates failure of generic log-concavity. No claim that all listed 2014 open questions have unchanged 2026 status.

sources.authors: Griffin, Ono, Rolen, Thorner, Tripp, Wagner
sources.title: Jensen polynomials for the Riemann xi-function
sources.use: Definitions (1.1)-(1.2), Theorems 1.1-1.2 and Corollary 1.3. Already-known n>=c exp(d/2) and degree<=9.36e20 all-shift region. This is a published sufficient region, not a claimed sharp or latest frontier.

sources.title: Jensen polynomials for the Riemann zeta function and other sequences
sources.use: Classical Jensen-Polya program and fixed-degree eventual hyperbolicity; not worldwide novelty.
